scope: Freeze programme ownership and merge/delete dispositions only. This does not establish novelty, scientific correctness, final titles/numbers, venue fitness or publication authority.

P-A.role: structural donor discovery, reduction and conservative generalization methods
P-A.open_scientific_gate: incremental value over strongest donor-search/reduction/generalization parent composition

P-B.role: context-relative structural relations, comparability and transport
P-B.open_scientific_gate: protected cross-domain relation/transport value beyond parent-specific equivalence, abstraction, provenance and stochastic-transport methods

P-C.role: obligation-driven scientific solver with witnessed minimum-level escalation
P-C.open_scientific_gate: protected solver value and V1 non-regression versus strongest fixed/adaptive/donor-composed baselines

P-D.open_scientific_gate: incremental calibration/false-authority protection beyond strongest dependence and performative-evaluation parents

P-E.role: frontier opportunity discovery and problem finding
P-E.open_scientific_gate: protected prospective frontier value beyond novelty, LBD, portfolio and open-ended-search parents

contraction_invariants: no scientific mechanism may acquire novelty merely because a candidate paper was merged or renamed
shared theory has one primary paper owner with explicit method links rather than duplicate standalone claims
a deleted/merged candidate remains successful novelty contraction and its negative history is retained
P-E remains contingent and cannot be promoted by interestingness alone
C12 remains closed unless a later protected discriminator forces re-separation
